title: Personal Trainer in Bali
finding: Operator advertises in-person sessions from IDR 500,000 with travel to the customer. This is an advertised starting price, not a market average or independently audited service quality.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: Yoga Breeze Bali
finding: Advertises a 90 minute private yoga class at IDR 750,000 for one, with IDR 250,000 per additional person. Travel conditions differ by area; some areas list IDR 180,000 extra.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: BaliPrivateYoga
finding: Advertises IDR 1,800,000 per private class for one or two people, with travel and equipment; four classes IDR 6,400,000. An example of premium positioning, not evidence of sales volume.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: Bali Pilates Plus
finding: Lists a 50 minute private group villa class with price on request. Supports villa delivery as an existing format; does not supply a verified mat Pilates tariff.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: Unity Swimming School Bali
finding: Advertises a 45 minute villa coach visit at IDR 800,000, compared with a private 45 minute lesson at IDR 600,000. Pool format and duration matter when comparing prices.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: Home Service Massage Bali
finding: Advertises sports massage at IDR 450,000 / 600,000 / 750,000 for 60 / 90 / 120 minutes. The page gives conflicting table inclusion wording; reconfirm equipment and fees before using as a supplier quote. Its health benefit claims were not adopted.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: AYU SPA Bali
finding: The mobile menu lists 60 minute Balinese massage IDR 170,000, a 45 minute natural facial IDR 150,000 and an 80 minute manicure/pedicure combination IDR 280,000. These lower price anchors show the need to explain a premium offer. No supplier partnership or quality claim is implied.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: Hydro Medical Clinic Bali
finding: Lists a clinic physiotherapy session at IDR 350,000; home visits add a transport charge. This is not a verified all-in home visit price. Provider treatment claims were not adopted.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: PhysioActive Indonesia
finding: Jakarta comparator: lists a 45 minute physiotherapy home visit at IDR 2,010,000. Page heading says 2026 while body says valid from January 2025. This is an advertised national comparator, not a Bali price or confirmed current quote.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: Maya Ubud Resort & Spa
finding: Lists a 60 minute private sound experience for at most two at IDR 1,200,000++, in a resort setting. Tax and service are extra; this is not a mobile home visit rate. Spiritual or clinical claims were not adopted.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: Alchemy Wellness Canggu
finding: Lists a 90 minute combined naturopathy and nutrition consultation at IDR 3,200,000. This is a specialist venue comparator with a different scope, not a like-for-like dietitian home visit. Medical and root-cause claims were not adopted.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: myCHEF current price list
finding: Published full-day stay chef: chef and assistant, IDR 3,267,000 including tax and service, with a minimum three-meal package and groceries extra at cost. It says meals may be used across days. This is context for coordinating the existing business, not an approved new PersonalFitness chef tariff.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: IceBaths.com Bali rental
finding: Offers delivery, installation, maintenance and collection for Bali ice bath rentals. No usable public fixed price was found on the reviewed page. Use a supplier quote rather than inventing a rental price.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: Bodywise Bali women's health
finding: Shows local specialist women's health physiotherapy as an existing category, including pregnancy, postnatal and pelvic health. Home availability, price and practitioner permissions still require confirmation.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: BIMC Bali home care
finding: Describes hospital home care including doctor and nurse visits, physiotherapy and laboratory services. Supports a partner referral option; no commercial arrangement with PersonalFitness exists from this research.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: Kemenkes Permenkes 13/2025
finding: Official health workforce regulation. Its registration and practice permission provisions are a starting point for specialist diligence, alongside current local requirements. A general professional certificate alone does not establish authority for a home clinical service.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: Indonesia personal data law 27/2022
finding: Official law record; health information and children's data require particular care under the personal data framework. The implementation brief keeps sensitive intake separate from public enquiries, marketing analytics and general AI context.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: NCCIH Reiki overview
finding: NCCIH states that Reiki has not been clearly shown effective for health purposes and does not support the proposed energy field. If retained, sell only an optional relaxation experience; do not claim treatment benefits.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: Google Search JavaScript guidance
finding: Google describes crawling, rendering and indexing, and recommends server or pre-rendering as useful for users and crawlers. A JavaScript site can be indexed, but an app shell alone does not establish crawlability.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: Google HTTP status guidance
finding: Google does not index content returned with most 4xx status codes, including 404. Direct route responses must be corrected; a 200 response is still not an indexing guarantee.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: IKMI lactation counsellor directory
finding: The professional association directory contains Bali entries and home visit formats. This is a candidate discovery lead only, not current availability, independent verification or a booking arrangement.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: IndoPsyCare fee page
finding: Lists home visit surcharges by 30 minute units, alongside other fees. These are not complete session prices. No numeric psychology market range was inferred from those surcharges.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.

title: PersonalFitness.id live review
finding: Read homepage, services hub, all three service details, locations, pricing, process, about, FAQ and privacy in the live browser. Reviewed contact form and public app assets. Standard unauthenticated GETs found deep route 404 responses. No analytics, Search Console, private CMS, booking operations or supplier records were accessed.
evidence_limits: Public advertised information, unless the finding explicitly says live observation. No supplier contacted.
